meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 它给 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器装上固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI 和一个转换技能,让 agent 在容器内把附加的 Word、Excel、PPT 等文档转成 Markdown,不经过外部托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附件里的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档,又不想把它们上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown,只总结相关段落
say.note: 会在容器内本地转换并输出 Markdown

say.text: 确认这个只有图片的 PDF 转换会明确失败,不要上传
say.note: 会报错并保持留在本地

say.text: 检查容器里的 anydoc 版本,并跑一次 CSV 转换验证
say.note: 会做版本检查和转换冒烟测试

howto.what_en: It installs a pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI and a conversion skill into NanoClaw agent containers, so agents turn attached Word, Excel, PowerPoint and similar documents into Markdown locally, without a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Use when agents must read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and similar office documents without sending them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word file to Markdown and summarize relevant sections
Confirm the image-only PDF fails clearly and is not uploaded
Check the anydoc version in the container and run a CSV conversion test
say_en.note: Runs version check and smoke test.
